text:
I’m a passionate and hard-working full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building modern web applications, and I’d love to help you develop your e-commerce website from scratch with Laravel and VueJS.

While my background is centered on JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST API development, Tailwind CSS, Stripe, and full-stack product work, I’m very comfortable moving between front-end and back-end layers to deliver polished, reliable applications. For an e-commerce build, I understand the importance of clean user flows, scalable architecture, secure integrations, and an interface that makes browsing and checkout feel smooth.

One project that reflects my experience is the Streaming chat widget I built for Quillstack in edtech. I created the front end and a Node proxy for a tutoring chat that streams answers token by token. That work achieved first token on screen in about 600 ms and supported 30k chats a month. It was a strong example of building responsive, production-ready user experiences with real-time behavior and careful attention to performance.

For your Laravel and VueJS e-commerce project, I’d bring the same practical approach: building a solid foundation, keeping the UI intuitive, and making sure the application is structured well for future growth. I’m especially comfortable working on full-stack features that involve APIs, dynamic interfaces, authentication flows, and payment-related functionality.

I know an e-commerce website needs more than just pages and components. It needs dependable product browsing, cart and checkout experiences, and a backend that can support business logic cleanly. I focus on writing maintainable code and collaborating closely to make sure the final product matches the goals of the project.

If you’re looking for someone who can take an e-commerce website from idea to implementation with a strong product mindset and broad full-stack experience, I’d be glad to discuss your needs and how I can contribute.
